summary: Revised implementation plan for CureX: Pure 'CureX' branding (no 'level 2' subtitle in brand), expanded roster of verified doctors across major Indian cities and specialties, enhanced interactive hospital radar and map locator with live navigation and 24/7 emergency trauma filters, and a ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude-grade AI healthcare chatbot with encyclopedic clinical knowledge, Google Search grounding, multi-turn conversational memory, and medical triage.
